UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Employment and salary profile for an authenticated Kenyan user, isolated from PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the document owner.

salaryAmount.description: Monthly salary figure in Kenyan Shillings (KES).

salaryType.description: Indicates whether salaryAmount is gross or net pay.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivatePii.title: UserPrivatePii
UserPrivatePii.description: Strictly isolated PII contact record for the user under the Split Collection strategy.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the document owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the PII record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the PII record was last updated.

UserBasketData.title: UserBasketData
UserBasketData.description: Optional user-configured cost of a basket of goods across 2021-2026 in KES.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the document owner.

basketName.description: Label for the tracked household basket of goods.

notes.description: Optional notes describing items included in the basket.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the basket was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the basket was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each user's employment metadata and saved monthly salary preferences.

/users/{userId}/private/{piiId}.description: Split-collection storage for isolated user PII (email address) restricted to owner.

/users/{userId}/baskets/{basketId}.description: Stores user-entered 2021-2026 basket of goods price series.
